ceo.heading: What CEO says?
ceo.quote: Our focus is growing together across sectors, teams, and every level of collaboration.

story.heading: Our story
story.body:
Amalia Utama started as a small team-kit supplier and has grown into a national distributor for two performance sportswear brands. What began with local club orders now covers school programmes, futsal venues, sports retailers and corporate teams throughout the archipelago.

Our focus has not changed: keep genuine product in stock, quote quickly, and get kit delivered before the season starts. Most of our customers come back each year, which means we plan our stock around real team calendars rather than seasonal guesswork.

statement.heading: Official distributor statement
statement.body: Amalia Utama is an authorised distributor of Kelme and Adidas products for the Indonesian market. All goods we supply are genuine, sourced through official channels, and covered by the manufacturers' standard warranty terms.
